playstyle.identity: Zaahen is a skirmisher who excels at extended duels and jungle clear. He can be played in both top lane and jungle, using his kit to outplay opponents in 1v1 situations.
playstyle.howToPlay: Look for isolated duels and extended trades where your sustained damage shines. In jungle, use efficient clear patterns and look for skirmish opportunities. In top, trade aggressively when abilities are available.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zaahen spikes with his first completed item. Trinity Force or bruiser items synergize well with his kit. He's strong in the mid-game with item advantages.
